endpoints.name: TikTok Profiles API
endpoints.description: Retrieve normalized public TikTok profile identity, biography, account flags, and visible follower, following, video, and like counts by username.

endpoints.name: TikTok Hashtags API
endpoints.description: Collect normalized public TikTok videos for one or more hashtags, with creator, caption, engagement, media, sound, and matched-hashtag context.

hashtags.description: Hashtags with or without the # prefix.

endpoints.name: TikTok Comments API
endpoints.description: Collect normalized publicly visible top-level TikTok comments from direct video URLs, including text, author context, likes, reply counts, mentions, and creator interaction flags.

endpoints.name: TikTok Videos API
endpoints.description: Retrieve normalized public TikTok video metadata from direct video URLs, including creator, caption, engagement, cover references, hashtags, mentions, and sound details.

endpoints.name: TikTok Search API
endpoints.description: Search public TikTok videos by query and return normalized video records with supported relevance, date, likes, and publication-window filters.

endpoints.name: TikTok Comment Replies API
endpoints.description: Collect public TikTok replies for one comment using a video URL and comment ID, returning text, authors, timestamps, engagement, and parent context as normalized records.

url.description: A public content or product URL.

endpoints.name: TikTok Followers List API
endpoints.description: Collect normalized public profile records visible in the follower lists of one or more TikTok usernames, with source context and available public metrics.

endpoints.name: TikTok Following List API
endpoints.description: Collect normalized public profiles followed by one or more TikTok usernames, including identity, biography, avatar, visible profile metrics, and source username.

endpoints.name: TikTok User Videos API
endpoints.description: Collect public TikTok videos from one or more usernames, returning captions, creators, media, timestamps, and visible engagement as normalized account-linked records.

endpoints.name: TikTok Live Room Info API
endpoints.description: Retrieve a point-in-time public TikTok live room snapshot from its room and owner IDs, including title, status, owner identity, cover image, viewer count, and like count.

endpoints.name: TikTok Trending Feed API
endpoints.description: Collect the current public TikTok video feed for a region code, returning video IDs, captions, creators, cover images, timestamps, and visible engagement.

endpoints.name: TikTok Video Transcript API
endpoints.description: Extract transcripts from public TikTok video URLs with an optional language, returning text, language, format, source links, and collection time as normalized records.

endpoints.name: TikTok Search Users API
endpoints.description: Search public TikTok creators and accounts by keyword, returning normalized identity, biography, account flags, and visible follower, following, and video counts.

endpoints.name: TikTok Song API
endpoints.description: Collect detailed public TikTok sound and music metadata by clip ID or sound URL, returning author, album, duration, audio links, and video usage count.

music_id.description: TikTok sound clip ID from a music URL.

url.description: A public content or product URL.

endpoints.name: TikTok Song Videos API
endpoints.description: Collect public TikTok videos that use a specific sound, returning normalized video metadata, creator details, captions, media links, and engagement counters.

music_ids.description: TikTok sound clip IDs from music URLs.

endpoints.name: TikTok Popular Songs API
endpoints.description: Get the TikTok Top 50 or Viral 50 songs chart, with track names, artists, sound IDs and available video counts to help you build a music list for review.

chart_type.description: TikTok App music chart: top for Top 50, viral for Viral 50.

requestSchema.description: Choose the TikTok App Top 50 (top, default) or Viral 50 (viral) music chart. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts integers from 1 to 50.

endpoints.name: TikTok Top Search API
endpoints.description: Search TikTok videos and photo carousels by keyword, with captions, creator details, media links and engagement counts returned together in one JSON list.

requestSchema.description: query is required. results_limit defaults to 100. Results can contain videos and photo carousels; region changes content availability and does not guarantee geographic filtering.

endpoints.name: TikTok User Live API
endpoints.description: Check whether public TikTok accounts are live by username, returning live or offline status and available room details for multiple accounts in one request.

requestSchema.description: Provide a non-empty usernames array. Each successful lookup returns one billable status, including is_live=false for offline accounts.

endpoints.name: TikTok Audience Demographics API
endpoints.description: Retrieve the country breakdown of a public TikTok account's followers by username, returning each country's name, ISO code, audience share, and sampled follower count.

username.description: TikTok username, with or without the leading @.

requestSchema.description: username is required. Returns one result with the countries the account's followers are located in, each with its share of the audience.

endpoints.name: TikTok Similar Accounts API
endpoints.description: Find public TikTok accounts that TikTok recommends as similar to a username, returning handles, display names, bios, follower and video counts, and verification status.

username.description: TikTok username, with or without the leading @.

requestSchema.description: username is required. Returns accounts TikTok recommends as similar to it. results_limit defaults to 30 and accepts 1 to 300.

endpoints.name: TikTok Reposts API
endpoints.description: Collect the videos a public TikTok account has reposted from its username, returning each video's caption, original author, views, likes, hashtags, and video file.

username.description: TikTok username, with or without the leading @.

requestSchema.description: username is required. Returns the videos the account has reposted, newest first. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 500.

endpoints.name: TikTok Playlists API
endpoints.description: List the public playlists of a TikTok account by username, returning each playlist's ID, name, link, cover image, video count, and owner details.

username.description: TikTok username, with or without the leading @.

requestSchema.description: username is required. Returns the account's public playlists with their video counts. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 100.

endpoints.name: TikTok Hashtag Views API
endpoints.description: Look up as many as 20 TikTok hashtags in one request, returning each hashtag's ID, link, total video count, and total views for side-by-side comparison.

hashtags.description: Hashtag names with or without the # prefix, up to 20 per request.

requestSchema.description: hashtags is required: 1 to 20 hashtag names. Returns one result per hashtag with its total video count and view count.

endpoints.name: TikTok Sound Search API
endpoints.description: Search TikTok's sound library by keyword, returning sound IDs, titles, artists, cover art, durations, playable previews, and how many videos use each sound.

query.description: Song title, artist or sound name to search for.

region.description: Two-letter country code of the TikTok market to search.

sort_by.description: Order of the results: relevance, most_used or latest.

requestSchema.description: query is required. Returns sounds matching it; sort_by orders them by relevance (default), most_used or latest. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 500.

endpoints.name: TikTok Live Search API
endpoints.description: Search TikTok LIVE streams broadcasting now by keyword, returning room IDs, stream titles, hosts, current viewers, likes, and start times, ready for product lookups.

query.description: Keyword to find LIVE streams for.

requestSchema.description: query is required. Returns LIVE streams that are broadcasting now and match it, with their current viewers. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 200.

endpoints.name: TikTok Photo Search API
endpoints.description: Search TikTok photo carousel posts by keyword, returning every slideshow image along with captions, authors, hashtags, views, likes, comments, and shares.

query.description: Keyword to find photo posts for.

requestSchema.description: query is required. Returns photo carousel posts matching it, with every image in the carousel. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 500.

endpoints.name: TikTok Trending Searches API
endpoints.description: Collect today's trending searches on TikTok in a single call, returning about 100 search phrases in TikTok's ranked order with a ready-made search link for each.

requestSchema.description: Takes no input. Returns today's trending search keywords on TikTok, in TikTok's order.

endpoints.name: TikTok Creator Search Insights API
endpoints.description: Retrieve popular TikTok searches from Creator Search Insights, returning each search's popularity score, seven-point trend, related video count, category, and labels.

category.description: Limit the searches to one content category.

filter_by.description: all for popular searches, or content_gap for searches that have few videos yet.

language.description: Language of the searches to return.

requestSchema.description: All fields are optional. Returns 20 searches popular on TikTok, each with a popularity score, a seven-point trend and its video count; language, category and filter_by narrow them.

endpoints.name: TikTok Live Ranking API
endpoints.description: Collect TikTok's LIVE daily creator ranking in one call, returning up to 99 hosts with their rank, gift-based score, username, display name, and follower count.

requestSchema.description: Takes no input. Returns TikTok's LIVE daily creator ranking, up to the top 99 creators with their scores.

endpoints.name: TikTok Live Shopping API
endpoints.description: Collect the products in a TikTok LIVE stream's shopping bag from its room and host IDs, returning titles, current prices, units sold, seller IDs, and product images.

room_id.description: Numeric ID of the LIVE room.

user_id.description: Numeric TikTok user ID of the LIVE host.

requestSchema.description: room_id and user_id are required; both come from TikTok Live Search results. Returns the products in the stream's shopping bag. results_limit defaults to 100 and accepts 1 to 500.

endpoints.name: TikTok Fake Views Checker API
endpoints.description: Check a public TikTok video URL for fake views, returning a fake-view score, estimated fake views and their share, the traffic tier reached, and the main reason found.

category.description: Content type used to pick engagement benchmarks: general, entertainment, education, product or verified_large.

url.description: TikTok video or photo post URL, such as https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890123456789.

requestSchema.description: url is required. Returns one analysis with a fake-view score, the estimated share of inauthentic views and the traffic tier the video reached.

endpoints.name: TikTok Comment Keywords API
endpoints.description: Extract the keywords that come up most in a public TikTok video's comments from its URL, returning ranked keywords, each with the comments and likes behind it.

url.description: TikTok video or photo post URL, such as https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890123456789.

requestSchema.description: url is required. Returns the keywords that come up most in the video's comments, each with the comments that mention it.
